name: Iron anchor
description: A large rusted iron anchor about 1.3 × 0.75 × 1.5 m standing on its crown: a tapered shank with a ring at the top, a ball-ended stock under it and two curved arms with spade flukes, leaning back on a tall coil of hemp rope whose end is tied to the ring.

provenance.prompt: A large rusted iron anchor leaning on a coil of rope, about 1.2 × 0.8 × 1.5 m.
